parameters.content:
## 1 — Router
One Telegram Trigger listens for BOTH `message` and `callback_query` updates.

`route update` splits them; `answer callback` stops Telegram's spinner on the tapped button, then `route callback` fans out on the button's callback_data.

**Nothing in this workflow sends the user to a URL.**

## 2 — Guided flow
Each button tap is its OWN execution. State is carried in two stateless ways:

• the choice is inside `callback_data`
• the link is recovered from `reply_to_message` (that's why the ask-nodes use Force Reply)

## 3 — Schedule chain (channel-keyed)
`channel_config.json` is keyed by CHANNEL:
`{ channels: { "UCxxx": { channelName, rssUrl, lastVideoId, subscribers: [] } } }`

One item per channel, so a channel two people follow is fetched and summarised ONCE. `fan out subscribers` then turns that single summary into one message per person.

Old file shapes (single-user, and the per-user map) migrate automatically on read.
